name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MaskedEval.otp_hop
title: One-time-pad hop: real-or-random security of a mask y gives WE security with loss 2
statement: For a finite additive group Y, a joint weight p(e, y) (evaluation key e, mask y) and any test g(e, y), the advantage |E_p[g(e, y + mu0)] - E_p[g(e, y + mu1)]| is at most the sum of the real-versus-ideal advantages of the two tests g(e, . + mu_b), where the ideal law keeps the marginal of e and draws y uniformly. This is the step from a witness PRF value (pseudorandom on false statements) to witness encryption of mu with a one-time pad.
